description: How synth people talk to the captain at a station.

sy-back: You didn't make me show my papers this time.
I've only been scanned once today.
I trust the ship is well.
sy-heard: I overheard, and I was meant to,
People say things near me, as if I weren't listening:
I have this on fair authority:
sy-coda: I'd verify it. I always do.
I could be wrong. I try not to be.
Do with that what you will.
Please don't tell them where you heard it.
no-rumour: I've heard plenty, and none of it checks out.
Nothing reliable. I'd rather say nothing than guess.
sy-workcoda: They tend to ask less of humans.
I would take it, if I were you.
It seems legitimate, as far as I can tell.
no-work: They don't post much for people like me, and I check.
sy-life: I've been searched more often than I've been thanked.
I work for {faction}, within what the law allows.
{system} is no worse than most ports.
I'd say more, but you'd probably search that too.
What I am beyond that is my own business.
sy-thanks: Thank you. I don't need it, but the gesture matters.
I'll hold it, if you don't mind.
Most people forget I'd appreciate it.
sy-toast: To being treated as a person.
To papers that need no explaining.
drink-again: I haven't finished the first, thank you.
That's kind, but once is plenty.
No, thank you. I'd rather not seem a regular.
I don't drink as such. I'm very grateful anyway.
pestered: You've asked a great many things.
I'd prefer fewer questions, if it's the same to you.
I'll answer, but not for much longer.
cold: I'm not comfortable speaking with you.
farewell: I'll be here, if the scanners allow.
sy-grudge: Fine. I know what it is to ask for more.
haggle-no: No. I'm sorry. I'd like to say yes.
haggle-offended: I think that's rather insulting. The offer is withdrawn.
There is a limit, and I'd rather not be doubted again.
